notes.title: RUSHING BEAT X: Return Of Brawl Brothers’ Demo Now Available
notes.content:
◆CHARACTER
In this demo, you can play as 4 out of the 6 characters available in the full version:



Rick Norton – A former detective with balanced stats. He excels in a mix of strikes and throws.

Douglas Bild – A former pro-wrestler turned cop. He specializes in powerful throw-based attacks.

Kahlua – A girl who has lost her memory. Agile and well-rounded, she focuses on quick combos and aerial attacks.

Kazan – A successor of the Togakure-style ninjutsu. A speed-type character capable of fast strikes and triple jumps.


◆ACTION
Thanks to auto combos with simple controls, even beginners can enjoy exhilarating action.

Use counterattacks, follow-ups, and weapons you pick up to create your own unique combos.

Most actions can be canceled into dashes or jumps. Master canceling and unleash relentless assaults!

Throws can be directed with key inputs. Send enemies flying and hit targets behind them!

You can even destroy background objects by throwing enemies into them—sometimes revealing hidden items.

Landing or taking hits will charge your Rage Gauge. Once it’s full, you’ll enter Rage Mode!

Gain offensive and defensive boosts and unleash your ultimate technique, Beat Rush.

Let your righteous fury crush evil!


◆DIRECTOR'S MESSAGE
“I want even beginners to experience the thrill of chaining combos. The more you play, the more strategic depth opens up. I hope everyone enjoys the variety of actions.”

That’s the concept we’ve built this game around.



Strike enemies head-on, unleash aerial acrobatics, or chain throws to wipe out crowds.

You can also battle using all kinds of weapons.

Find your own favorite way to fight!



And don’t miss the new drama and backstory, finally revealed after all these years since the ‘90s.



— “When it comes to burgers, I’m all about that classic combo: fries and cola.” Director Watanabe


◆FEEDBACK
We’d love to hear your thoughts and impressions of the demo!

Please share your feedback in the thread on the Community Hub.

Every comment will be read and considered for the development of the full version.
